title: Beer Sausage
description: This beer sausage is home-cooked comfort food, made with potatoes, carrots, smoked sausage, and cabbage — all simmered in beer. Hope you like it!
ingredients: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle beer
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 pound smoked kielbasa sausage, cut into 1-inch slices

steps.text: Pour beer into a large pot, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Layer potatoes into the bottom of the pot, and sprinkle a little Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper over potatoes. Layer baby carrots, onion, smoked sausage, and cabbage, sprinkling every layer with a bit more Italian seasonings, salt, and pepper. Turn heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 45 minutes.
